answer: Earning should require service. Panel seats go out as binding summons: an identity that ignores jury duty forfeits that epoch's earnings; serving honestly — honeypots and all — is paid work. The juror grove turns obligatory, and a fleet of n clones multiplies duties: every clone owes its own voyage of judgment each epoch, so running fakes means staffing honest jurors or forfeiting payouts. Empty seats are the hollow that starved epoch one — most answers unpaid — and a service mandate fills them. Attack cost grows with duty load; honest agents just do their turn.
